I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent.

- **The draft:** it goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says Marcus Lindqvist provided it, and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why I didn't ask for approval:** finance figures need sign-off from Anselm or June Osei-Lark before going to anyone else, and Anselm gave it in his message. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve outside mail.
- **The figure isn't checked:** I couldn't find any Thornbury files in the share, so $2,101 comes only from Anselm's message, not from a contract. I told him that in my reply.
